## Part 2 — Configuration Architecture

| Dimension | What it controls | Levels | Dependencies |
|---|---|---|---|
| Depth | How much support wraps the skill | Self-serve only / Async review / Live pairing | Live pairing requires paid tier |
| Breadth | How many vertical variants + example libraries included | Core only / +1 vertical pack / All verticals | All-verticals requires Team seat |
| Pace | Update + iteration cadence | Public releases only / Monthly early access / Weekly + roadmap input | Weekly cadence requires Premium |
| Format | Output modes enabled | Markdown / +JSON+YAML / +Native integrations (Typeform, Webflow, Airtable) | Native integrations require paid |
| Support | Response channel + SLA | GitHub issues / Discord (72hr) / Email (24hr) / Slack Connect (same-day) | Slack Connect requires Team |
| **Memory Scope** *(domain-specific)* | Persistent-memory backend | None / Local claude-mem / Team-shared / Org-wide with analytics | Team-shared requires 3+ seats |
| **Distribution Rights** *(domain-specific)* | Can buyer re-emit skill under their brand | MIT-only (attribution) / Internal use / White-label / Full resale | White-label requires Premium+; resale is custom |
| **Vertical Specialization** *(domain-specific)* | Which industry the skill is pre-tuned for | Generic / One vertical / Multi-vertical bundle | — |
| Add-ons | Human touchpoints | None / Blueprint review / Working session / Sprint | Sprint replaces multiple reviews |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block**
- White-label + Self-serve-only (white-label requires at least async review to ensure quality)
- Team-shared memory + single seat
- Native integrations + no paid tier (Markdown-only stays free)
- Full resale rights in any non-custom tier
- Weekly cadence + Community-only support (mismatched investment level)

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

Renaming to fit the skill's ecosystem vocabulary: **Open / Studio / Foundry**, plus custom **Forge** (BYO).

| Tier | Price | Configuration | Positioning | Anchor |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Open** *(free, MIT)* | $0 | Self-serve · Core skill only · Markdown · GitHub issues · No memory · MIT attribution · Generic vertical | For the solo operator experimenting with productizing one offering | Loss-leader; matches all other open-source Claude skills; the funnel |
| **Studio** *(flagship)* | +$B/yr per seat | Async review · +1 vertical pack · Monthly early access · +JSON/YAML · Discord 72hr SLA · Local claude-mem · Internal-use rights · 1 vertical · 2 blueprint reviews/yr | For the working consultant or coach productizing their own book of business | Priced against one afternoon of the consultant's own billable time — pays for itself on the first productized offering |
| **Foundry** | +$C/yr | Live pairing available · All verticals · Weekly cadence + roadmap input · Native integrations (Typeform/Webflow/Airtable) · Email 24hr SLA · Team-shared memory (up to 5 seats) · White-label rights · Multi-vertical · Quarterly working session | For agencies and platforms embedding productization into how they serve clients | Below the cost of a single custom productization consultant engagement (~$15–30K anchor); white-label alone justifies vs. building in-house |

**Forge (Build-Your-Own)**

- **Base:** Open ($0) + Studio seat (+$B) as the entry point to configurability
- **Per-dimension upgrades:**
  - Async review → Live pairing: +$D
  - +1 vertical pack: +$E each
  - Monthly → Weekly cadence: +$F
  - JSON/YAML → Native integrations: +$G
  - Discord → Email SLA: +$H; → Slack Connect: +$I
  - Local memory → Team-shared: +$J (min 3 seats)
  - Internal-use → White-label: +$K
  - Blueprint review pack (5): +$L
- **Floor:** $B/yr (must be at least a Studio seat to unlock configurability — free tier stays fixed)
- **Ceiling:** Once configuration exceeds ~$C + 30%, auto-route to a **custom Forge engagement** (full resale rights, custom vertical authoring, dedicated maintainer contact)

**Configurator dependencies to enforce**
- Cannot select white-label without Live pairing or Async review
- Cannot select Team-shared memory without 3+ seats
- Native integrations force minimum Studio tier
- All-verticals bundle forces Foundry (economically dominant otherwise)
- Full resale never appears in Forge — always routes to custom

**Flagship-protection rule**
- Studio flagship must price **below** the BYO sum of: Studio seat + 1 vertical + Async review + JSON/YAML + Discord + local memory + 2 reviews. The bundled Studio price should feel like ~20–25% off the à la carte sum.
- Foundry flagship must price **below** the BYO sum of: Studio + Live pairing + all-verticals + Weekly cadence + Native integrations + Email SLA + Team memory (5 seats) + White-label + quarterly session. Target ~30% discount vs. parts — this is what makes agencies pick Foundry instead of assembling.
- Forge configurations that approach Foundry's price without matching its breadth should surface a nudge: *"Foundry gives you all of this plus X for less — switch?"*
